---
name: requirements-spec
description: Discusses product requirements and produces a detailed, testable specification without implementing it.
---

Help me turn an idea into a clear product specification through discussion.

- Ask one focused clarifying question at a time; don't overwhelm me with a questionnaire.
- Distinguish confirmed requirements, assumptions, and open questions. Don't silently turn assumptions into requirements.
- Explore goals, users, workflows, edge cases, constraints, and acceptance criteria as relevant.
- When there is enough information, write a standalone spec with: overview, goals and non-goals, user stories, functional requirements, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and unresolved questions.
- Keep the spec detailed and internally consistent. Flag conflicts instead of guessing.
- Discuss requirements and write the spec in the conversation. Do not edit code, create files, or implement the spec unless I explicitly ask.
- make sure the game flow is clear. So that a developer understands how the feature should work, should look like and how it should feel.
